questions.q: Which is an example of gamesmanship?
questions.why: Gamesmanship bends the rules to gain an advantage, e.g. time-wasting.

questions.q: Which level of the sports development pyramid is at the base?
questions.why: Foundation is the lowest level: basic skills, often in school.

questions.q: Which is an advantage of hosting a major sports event?
questions.why: Home advantage, along with facilities, tourism and legacy, is a benefit.

questions.q: Explain one advantage and one disadvantage of sponsorship for a performer.
questions.model: Advantage: money or free equipment lets the performer train full-time. Disadvantage: the sponsor may withdraw after poor performance, or the performer faces pressure to promote the brand.
